_readme: RSS/Atom channels for /last-entra-changes (agent-entra-change-tracker).
This file ships EMPTY on purpose. Add your own channels to the 'feeds'
array below — it is the only file you need to touch to switch the agent on.
Feed entry keys:
name        required. Shown in the report's Source column.
url         required. RSS 2.0 or Atom feed URL.
enabled     optional, default true. Set false to park a channel without
deleting it; the report footer lists it as disabled.
scope_hint  optional. Nudges the agent's Scope/Area classification when
the channel is single-subject, e.g. 'Global Secure Access'.
include     optional array of case-insensitive regexes. An item is kept
only if one of them matches its title, summary, categories or
url. Use this on BROAD channels (a general Azure or M365 feed)
to keep identity items only. Omit or leave empty for a channel
that is already Entra-only.
exclude     optional array of case-insensitive regexes. Any match drops the
item; applied before include.
note        optional free text, surfaced in the report footer when the
channel is disabled or errors.
'global_include' / 'global_exclude' apply to every channel in addition to
the per-feed lists.
Example entry (delete the surrounding quotes and paste into 'feeds'):
"name": "Microsoft Entra Blog",
"url": "https://example.com/entra/rss",
"enabled": true,
"include": ["\\bentra\\b", "conditional access"],
"exclude": []
Check what is wired up with:
python3 scripts/entra-feeds.py --list-feeds
